observability_triage.rationale: The objective subrequirement is that ESP32 breakout pin headers are not populated while the through-hole breakout remains usable. That distinction requires real pad/hole geometry plus assembly BOM and placement/DNP observables; the current package has only a generic zero-pin breakout component and no manufacturing population artifacts.
repair_requirements: Generate a real ESP32 breakout symbol/footprint with numbered plated-through pads and drill geometry.
Generate an assembly BOM and placement/DNP artifact that distinguishes retained holes from unpopulated pin headers.

evidence: The breakout component has a generic footprint and no pins or pads.
No BOM, CPL/positions, or DNP artifact exists to prove that connectors are omitted from assembly.
missing_observables: Absence of pin-header line items from assembly population data
minimum_environment_repairs: Generate a real ESP32 breakout symbol/footprint with numbered plated-through pads and drill geometry.
Generate an assembly BOM and placement/DNP artifact that distinguishes retained holes from unpopulated pin headers.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author after the board and assembly outputs separately expose breakout holes and pin-header population status.

uncovered_items.evidence: The current KiCad and build outputs cannot distinguish bare breakout holes from fitted pin headers.
uncovered_items.required_action: Repair the stated artifact surface before validator authoring.
